title: Introducing Binance UI Refined for App Pro Mode
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, We’re pleased to introduce  Binance UI Refined  — a complete redesign of the  Pro Mode homepage  on the Binance App. With this update, users can customize their homepage with widgets, use AI to track market insights, and personalise their trading view in a single, refined interface. Key Features: Drag-and-drop widgets:  Build your own dashboard with resizable widgets that bring data, price trends, and top trader performance to your homepage — helping you track opportunities and make more informed decisions. AI-powered insights:  Your AI trending widget identifies and aggregates data from across social media channels and Binance Square, providing social sentiment, trading signals, and insights around specific tokens. Refined visual design:  New fonts, icons, spacing, and a Midnight Dark Theme for enhanced clarity and focus. How to Get Started: Open the Binance App. Tap on the Widgets banner on the Binance App homepage to customize your view. Press and hold to edit widgets. Tap “Edit Homepage”. Add widgets. Choose your widgets. Select a size. Your homepage is now customized! Currently Available Widgets: AI Trending:  View real-time market sentiment and trending tokens based on aggregated social signals (X and Binance Square). Coin List:  Explore categorized token lists with flexible layout options and direct access to trade. Coin Spotlight:  Track selected coins with live price movements and direct access to trading (Spot/Convert). Copy Trading:  Follow top traders with real-time 7-day PnL data for Spot and Futures Copy Trading. ETF Net Flow:  Monitor BTC and ETH ETF flows to track shifts in institutional market sentiment. Fear and Greed:  See daily market sentiment scores to help react to changing market conditions. Hot Category:  Identify the top-performing market categories (DeFi, AI, Meme, etc.) based on 24-hour Market Cap change. Simple Earn:  Check live APR rankings across Simple Earn Flexible Products. Notes: This update is available on Android version 2.101.8 and iOS version 2.101.4 of the Binance App in Pro Mode. Widget availability may vary by region and regulatory restrictions. Additional widgets and further refinements may be released in future updates. There may be discrepancies between this original content in English and any translated versions. Please refer to the original English version for the most accurate information, in case any discrepancies arise. Thank you for your support! Binance Team 2025-06-12
